description: v2.3.1 (pre-release re-cut #4; replaces the earlier v2.3.1 assets). Adds Gemini (com.google.android.apps.bard): a dynamic-feature-shell analysis (docs/GEMINI.md) plus two scoped patches — 'Strip camera, mic, phone & contacts permissions' (storage always kept) and 'Gemini privacy hardening' (EnableTelemetry=false, Primes lifeboat receiver disabled at the manifest root). Running without Google Play Services is routed through the universal GmsCore support (MicroG) patch; a Google account is still required for chat. Carries re-cut #3's all-B*-bridge Mereframe sweep (#34/#35/#29) and re-cut #2's Netflix Android TV support.
